headline: Points Renews Southwest Airlines Partnership
summary:
TORONTO, Dec.  16, 2019  (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Points (TSX:PTS) (Nasdaq:PCOM), the global leader in powering loyalty commerce, today announced a long term renewal of its contract with Southwest Airlines (NYSE:LUV) beginning January 1, 2020. Through a single integration with Points’ Loyalty Commerce Platform, Southwest Airlines will continue to leverage a full suite of loyalty solutions designed to drive both increased revenue and member engagement.
